item.title: Nassau County employee buyout plan approved
item.description: Nassau legislators have unanimously approved a request to offer buyouts to county employees with over 10 consecutive years of full-time service. The Voluntary Separation Agreement between the county and its six public employee unions will be available to eligible employees from Feb. 1 to March 5.
